name: Calw (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over yellow, charged at the centre with the city arms of Calw (a red lion on yellow with a blue chief).
history: The arms were re-granted by the Regierungspräsidium Karlsruhe on 20 July 1976; the city flag is red and yellow.

features.role: Calw arms — red lion on yellow
